from_run: kg-run-aol-c01 (PR 5 round 6: runs/aol/20260928-042747-6d79ef8-fixture/propose/candidates.json c01), edited: every AOL detail removed; trigger_state_id and flow screens stay because the schema needs a screen

candidate.title: Play one short game to use the app without ads for 30 minutes
candidate.what_is_different_here: The app shows ads, and hiding them for a short window displaces little revenue.
candidate.adds: An opt-in banner that lets a user play one short sponsored game to hide ads in the app for 30 minutes.
candidate.trigger_event: The user has used the app for a while and a playable is loaded and ready
candidate.placement: A dismissible banner in the app
candidate.offer_copy: Play a quick game and use the app with no ads for the next 30 minutes.

reward.duration: 30 minutes from when the game ends

candidate.frequency_cap: 2 per day, resets at midnight local time; not shown while a window is active
candidate.decline_path: Closing the banner hides it for the rest of the day; the app works exactly as before.
candidate.ad_fail_path: If no game is ready the banner never appears. If the play is not confirmed, nothing changes and the try does not count.
candidate.subscriber_treatment: Every user sees the same offer.
candidate.advertiser_category: Casual mobile games, streaming services, and mainstream retail brands

flow_steps.caption: The user is in the app.
A banner offers 30 minutes with no ads for one quick game.
The user plays a short sponsored game.
The app shows no ads for 30 minutes.

candidate.after_reward: When the 30 minutes end, the ads return with a note that one more break is available today.
candidate.rationale: Users would rather not see ads, so one chosen game for a short ad-free window is a fair trade that can earn more than the ads it hides.

economics.assumption_line: Costs ~$0.0582 per reward to serve; pays for itself above $58.20 eCPM. A rewarded view earns $9.20-16.49 eCPM in North America on Android, $1.90 in LATAM. Assumes 30 ad-free minutes at 0.2 ads a minute, each worth $9.70 eCPM (the NA Android interstitial rate); if the ads it hides are banners ($0.55 eCPM), it pays for itself above $3.30; one view per reward; a publisher-net eCPM (share 1).
